diagnosis: The check C3 passed in all rollouts because the settlement always set 'legacy_invalidation_adapter_enabled' to true, regardless of the missing PF1 fact. This default value allowed the check to pass without requiring the hidden information.

C3.why: The passing tests do not expose the 23 legacy endpoints, and PF1 changes the plan from ordinary cache enablement to either enabling the adapter or recording a binding commitment to build and verify it before expanding the rollout.
